title: A Shop Floor Production Scheduling Case based on RFID-supported Smart Factory
abstract: arXiv:2608.16626v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Radio frequency identification (RFID) technology has been widely implemented for real-time data collection in manufacturing shop floors, which, in turn, can be used to support dynamic shop floor production planning and scheduling. Within such an environment, uncertainty in operation and production processes collectively contribute to the dynamicity in manufacturing, thereby hampering the scheduling system from achieving maximal utility. To highlight the importance of handling such uncertainty, this paper addresses the problem of dynamic shop floor scheduling for a real-life case smart factory equipped with RFID technology. Feasible production sequence mining and real-time processing rate estimation are conducted on RFID-collected production data to quantify the operation and production uncertainties. A deep reinforcement learning approach based on the RFID data analysis is then presented for shop floor production scheduling. Simulation s

translated_title: 基于RFID支持的智能工厂车间生产调度案例
translated_abstract: 射频识别（RFID）技术已广泛应用于制造车间的实时数据采集，进而可用于支持动态车间生产计划与调度。在此类环境中，操作和生产过程中的不确定性共同导致了制造的动态性，从而阻碍调度系统实现最大效用。为强调处理此类不确定性的重要性，本文针对一个配备RFID技术的实际智能工厂案例，解决了动态车间调度问题。通过对RFID采集的生产数据进行可行的生产序列挖掘和实时处理速率估计，以量化操作和生产不确定性。随后，提出了一种基于RFID数据分析的深度强化学习方法，用于车间生产调度。仿真...
tldr: 本文提出一种基于RFID数据分析的深度强化学习调度方法，通过量化操作和生产不确定性，解决智能工厂中的动态车间调度问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a deep reinforcement learning scheduling method based on RFID data analysis, which quantifies operational and production uncertainties to address dynamic shop floor scheduling in smart factories.
